_about: Tenth independent review of PR #78, I16 (DRAFT, PENDING owner approval): the error contract of POST /ai/report/generate. Every error the route returns carries error.code (machine-readable; error.details carries its parameters). The report panel maps each code to its own message (never a message prefix). Read by backend/tests/unit/test_verified_report_review10.py and frontend/src/components/AIReportPanel.errorCodes.test.tsx.

codes.en: No measurements are available for this study. Open a segmentation and run its analysis first: a report without measurements would be invented.
Open a segmentation first: the report is written for one analysed segmentation, and the request is checked against its patient's record. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The segmentation of this report was not found, or you may not open it. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The measurements belong to another segmentation than the one open. Reload the segmentation and try again. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The request for the report was not valid, so no draft was written. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The image geometry could not be read, so the report was not generated. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The lesion measurements could not be computed on the server, so the report was not generated. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The lesion count computed by the segmentation analysis is outside its plausible range, so no draft was written. Re-run the analysis or check the segmentation. Nothing was sent to the AI service.
The patient's record could not be read, so the request could not be checked and nothing was sent to the AI service. Try again later.
A label typed in the application reached the measurement record, so nothing was sent to the AI service and no draft was written. Please report this error.
A safety check refused the request, so nothing was sent to the AI service and no draft was written.
The report could not be generated because of an internal error; no draft was written.

fields.burden_tp1_ml: lesion volume of the previous visit
fields.total_lesions_tp1: lesion count of the previous visit
fields.new_lesion_min_diameter_mm: minimum size of a new lesion
